findings.title: Perceived mass member deletion was default 'Active members' filter hiding archived records
findings.description: Customer saw the admin Members list count drop from ~400 to 178 and believed members had been deleted. Root cause was the Members view defaulting to an 'Active members' filter, which hid the ~220 members she herself had archived the prior week following contractor departures. Switching the filter to 'All members' immediately restored the full count of 401, and a spot-check confirmed archived members retain full profile and session history. Resolved live on the call; no data loss occurred and no product defect was found (the filter and archive function behaved as designed).
findings.quote: I opened the admin panel this morning and half our members are gone. Deleted.
findings.severity_reason: No actual defect or data loss occurred; the underlying system behaved correctly and the scare was fully explained by customer-side action (forgotten bulk archiving) combined with a default filter.
findings.match_note: Not the same as PROJ-131 (search indexing delay for new invites) or any tracked bug; this is a default-view/filter confusion fully resolved as user error, with no matching catalogue issue.

findings.title: Customer unaware bulk-archive action already exists for Members list
findings.description: Customer asked whether there is a bulk way to archive members, having manually archived 220 members one-by-one the prior week, which took a long time and contributed to her forgetting the archiving had happened. Support confirmed a bulk archive action already exists in the Members list toolbar (select via checkboxes or select-all with a filter applied, then use the toolbar 'Archive' action). This is an existing product capability the customer was simply unaware of, not a missing feature or defect.
findings.quote: is there a bulk way to do it, or is it one at a time?
findings.severity_reason: No product gap exists; the requested capability is already shipped and was simply undiscovered by this user, with no ongoing impact after the call.
findings.match_note: Not in the tracked catalogue as a gap; explicitly confirmed on the call as existing functionality (bulk archive toolbar action), so there is nothing to file.
